result.summary: This PR fixes a bug where fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt accepted the snake_case option subtract_fee_from_outputs but silently ignored it when building recipients, only reading the camelCase subtractFeeFromOutputs internally. It adds a helper to check either spelling, updates RPC help text and the argument-conversion table, and adds functional test coverage for both RPCs.
result.problem: Users who pass subtract_fee_from_outputs (the documented alias in the shared funding-options validation) to fundrawtransaction or walletcreatefundedpsbt had the option silently ignored, meaning their intended fee-output behavior was not honored, which could produce unexpected transaction amounts.

result.card: This PR fixes a real bug where fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt silently ignored the documented snake_case option subtract_fee_from_outputs, only honoring the camelCase form internally, which could cause users to get unexpected fee-subtraction behavior. The fix is small and tested, and an initial doc-consistency objection from maflcko was resolved by the author. However, achow101 argued the real problem is a whole family of RPCs mixing camelCase and snake_case option names and suggested a unified fix instead of a one-off patch, and the author then asked whether to close this PR in favor of that broader effort; a reviewer said they'd prefer closing, and the author has been silent since 2026-06-24. The PR is Paused pending a decision on scope, and Agreement is Disputed given the unresolved scope objection. No formal dependency, but it may be superseded by a broader RPC-argument-naming unification effort.
